name: Vidra Hearthstove
summary: In Thelsamar, Vidra Hearthstove cooks local specialties at the Stoutlager Inn. She often relies on traveling adventurers to gather ingredients for her famous blood sausages.

sections.title: Kitchen of the Stoutlager
sections.body: Vidra Hearthstove cooks for locals and travelers at the Stoutlager Inn in Loch Modan. Sharing a surname with the innkeeper, she helps keep Thelsamar well provisioned. Her signature dish, Thelsamar blood sausages, calls for fresh game from the surrounding wilderness: boar entrails, spider ichor, and bear meat.

faq.answer: Vidra Hearthstove is a dwarf who lives and cooks at the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar. Her renowned Thelsamar blood sausages are served to patrons and Mountaineers defending Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where can Vidra Hearthstove be found?
faq.answer: You can find Vidra inside the Stoutlager Inn, in the center of Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

faq.q: What ingredients does she use for Thelsamar Blood Sausages?
aliases: what is in thelsamar blood sausages
faq.answer: Vidra's famous recipe calls for bear meat, boar intestines, and spider ichor from wildlife in Loch Modan.

angles.text: As a cook, Vidra turns harsh local ingredients into sustaining meals for hungry adventurers and mountain patrols, in the hearty, rustic tradition of Khaz Modan.
As a dwarf passing through Thelsamar, you can find a comforting taste of home in Vidra's kitchen, where her cooking helps keep town morale high.
